name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Edith goes with exactly one of Hazelnut, Cobalt, or Ivory.
Either Chai goes with Edith or Macchiato goes with Hugo.
Cinnamon goes with exactly two of Dane, Mocha, and Rose.
Dane goes with at least one of Hazelnut, Crimson, or Rose.
Felix, Chai, and Mocha go with Cinnamon, Hazelnut, and Toffee, in some order.
Cobalt goes with Hugo if and only if Cinnamon goes with Dane.
Dane goes with none of Mocha, Hazelnut, or Crimson.
Either Felix goes with Ivory, or Cinnamon goes with Crimson — but not both.
